subject: Security & deployment follow-up: SOC 2, VPC options, and SSQ initiation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security & deployment follow-up: SOC 2, VPC options, and SSQ initiation

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the level of detail from your end. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- SOC 2: You mentioned Acme is SOC 2 Type II in progress and will have the latest report by Q3. Please confirm expected delivery date and whether a pre-audit summary is available.
- GDPR/HIPAA: You indicated GDPR is a requirement; HIPAA may apply for a subset of workloads.
- SSQ: Per your request, I can send over our standard vendor SSQ and outline what we need from Acme to complete it.
- Private deployment: We discussed a VPC/private control plane option and an on-prem air-gapped pattern for sensitive workloads. You asked for a deployment diagram and notes on network isolation and key management.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll attach a short security one-pager and a template SSQ for your team to start filling out.
2) Could you share the estimated SOC 2 delivery date and whether Acme security prefers to own the SSQ (we’ll accept a completed doc) or go through a short questionnaire call?
3) If helpful, I can loop in our security lead (Marcus) and solutions architect (Rishi) to do a 30-min technical Q&A next week — they can walk through the VPC/on-prem options and draft a deployment diagram tailored to your environment.

Attaching: RW_Security_Overview.pdf (summary), sample SSQ template.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the SOC 2 timing and preferred SSQ flow and we’ll schedule the technical call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0164

Attachment: RW_Security_Overview.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
Attachment: SSQ_Sample_Template.docx (DOCX, 120KB)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Security Team <security@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security & deployment follow-up: SOC 2, VPC options, and SSQ initiation

Hi Marissa —

Great recap, thanks. Quick answers from our side: 

- SOC 2: Our external auditor expects to finalize the Type II report by 2028-09-15. We can share an interim controls summary by 2028-07-01.
- GDPR/HIPAA: GDPR absolutely applies. HIPAA applies to a small subset of customers — we can flag which dataflows are in-scope once you share the SSQ.
- SSQ: We’ll start with the SSQ you attached. I’m attaching our partially-completed SSQ with initial answers in sections 1-3; security will complete the rest.
- Private deployment: We’d like to see your recommended VPC architecture, and we are specifically interested in an air-gapped option for model training inference in a secured environment. Please include KMS/HSM options and network egress controls.

Available for a joint call next Wed or Thu 10-12 PT.

Attaching: Acme_SSQ_Completed.docx (partial)

Thanks,
Sarah
Director, Cloud Platforms | Acme Analytics
sarah.lee@acme-analytics.com

Attachment: Acme_SSQ_Completed.docx (DOCX, 850KB)

Folks — forwarding Acme’s partial SSQ and their notes. They expect SOC 2 final report ~2028-09-15 and will provide an interim controls summary by 7/1. They’re asking for:

- A deployment diagram for a VPC/private control plane option plus an air-gapped variant.
- Details on KMS/HSM integrations, key rotation, and whether customer-managed keys are supported.
- A short explanation of network isolation, egress controls, and audit logging retention.

Can Marcus or Rishi take point on the SSQ review and draft a small deployment diagram (PNG) we can send back? Ideally a 30-min technical Q&A with their security team next Wed/Thu 10-12 PT.

Quoted message below.

--Marissa

Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Security & deployment follow-up: SOC 2, VPC options, and SSQ initiation

Thanks for the ping, Marissa — I’ll take the lead on the SSQ review. Initial notes after a quick pass: 

- SSQ gaps: Sections on data classification and key management need more detail from Acme (e.g., which datasets are PHI/PII). We should request the interim controls summary to validate encryption-at-rest controls.
- SOC 2 timing: 9/15 works as an expected anchor for contract milestones; propose we include a contract clause for delivery of the report or an agreed remediation timeline.
- VPC deployment: We’ll prepare two diagrams: (1) Private control plane in a customer VPC with peered inference subnets + NAT egress control; (2) Air-gapped on-prem pattern with a locked-down inference cluster, no outbound internet, and offline key import via HSM.

Action items for us:
1) Rishi — can you draft both diagrams and a short bullets doc on KMS/HSM options and key rotation? Aim to have a first draft by EOD tomorrow.
2) Marissa — please propose a joint technical call window (Wed/Thu 10-12 PT) and I’ll join to walk through the diagrams.
3) Marissa/Acme — please share the interim controls summary and the completed SSQ sections on data classification when ready.

I’ll attach a preliminary deployment-diagram-vpc.png (PNG stub) and a short note on HSM options for reference.

– Marcus
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: deployment-diagram-vpc.png (PNG, 420KB)
Attachment: HSM_options_notes.txt (TXT, 6KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme-analytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security & deployment follow-up: SOC 2, VPC options, and SSQ initiation

Hi Sarah / team —

Thanks for the quick turn. I attached two diagram variants and a short bullets doc that explains:
- Network isolation: separate inference subnets with strict security groups, VPC endpoints for storage, and egress via customer-managed NAT + proxy.
- Air-gapped option: isolated cluster with no outbound paths, model artifacts transferred via signed offline packages and HSM-backed key import.
- KMS/HSM: we support both cloud KMS (customer-managed keys) and HSMs for key import; key rotation is supported via automated APIs and manual rotation workflows for air-gapped installs.

I can join Wed 19 Jun 2028 10:00-10:30 PT for a focused technical Q&A if that works for you — Marcus will join as well. Please confirm and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Notes: attaching deployment-diagram-vpc.png and deployment-diagram-airgap.png and an SSQ-responses-draft.docx with suggested answers for sections 4-7.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: deployment-diagram-vpc.png (PNG, 420KB), deployment-diagram-airgap.png (PNG, 380KB), SSQ-responses-draft.docx (DOCX, 150KB)
